---
title: Roadmap
---

The build-out runs in three gates. One gate = one named milestone: it ships
when its scenarios pass and their evidence posts ([ADR-0002](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-release-gates.md)).
The live board carries the same set of cards:
[agentpcap — Roadmap & Build Board](https://github.com/users/shsingh/projects/7).

## Current phase

AG-0.1 build-out. The specification is in force and renders in CI; the
implementation starts with the workspace skeleton and the stdio class.

## Release gates

| Gate | Scenario | Measures |
|---|---|---|
| AG-0.1 | one lab host, one stdio MCP client and server | ledger chain verifies after rotation; no path writes; zero arguments stored |
| AG-0.2 | the fleet plus remote Streamable HTTP and one attributed-mode host | M3 coverage matrix; M4 capability drift |
| AG-1.0 | full fleet with seeded shadow deployments | M1 recall, M2 overhead delta, M3 full matrix, M4 fidelity, M5 triage precision, M6 handoff latency — gate rule: M1 passing with M3 at M2 cost |

## The measurement set

The six measurements map to the evaluation issues above: M1 → #26,
M2 → #25, M3 → #27, M4 → #28, M5 → #29, M6 → #30. Baselines come
from the published figures of the
[research note](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/agentpcap-paper.md).
